{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue from cleaned completed orders
total_revenue_cleaned = df_clean['revenue_float'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue_cleaned"}
